taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a shrub (FEIS, Howard 1993).

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS's devilsclub review (Howard 1993, read 2026-10-15): "an erect to slightly spreading, deciduous shrub from 3.3 to 10 feet (1-3 m) in height".

traits.fruit_type.note: FEIS's devilsclub review (Howard 1993, read 2026-10-15): "The fruit is a drupe with two to three seeds".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months.

generator.params.note: Red-flowering currant's values, changed by hand for devil's club: few, thick, upright, sparsely branched stems (FEIS, Howard 1993: "sparsely branched with sharp, dense prickles on stems") with dense prickles, and huge palmate leaves held flat near the stem tips over a terminal panicle of red fruit. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 1.8 m at 12 years in the open, within FEIS's 1-3 m (Howard 1993). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye: large, shallowly 7-lobed, sharply toothed leaves on long stalks; pale tan prickly stems; greenish-white flowers and a cone-shaped cluster of bright red fruit.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the core-species expansion (2026-10-15): sizes from FEIS and model estimates, drawing values from red-flowering currant's.
